name: Raikon Sky Strike
design: A dim red leader steps down over a tightening ground mark, then a red bolt with a white core strikes from the sky with forks, goes dark, re-strikes on another path and flickers once; the burnt channel cools and erodes while red cracks cool, arcs crawl between them, sparks fall, debris lands and ash rises off the scorch.

name: Raikon Blade Charge
design: Red motes and arcs are pulled in from the air onto the blade tip, the arcs jumping shorter and hotter while a crackling ring tightens and the core heats to white, then one star glint marks the release.

name: Raikon Thunder Wave
design: A red lightning wave tears out of the floor in a flare and races along the ground toward the target: short white-cored bolts rear up and lean forward at its front while arcs re-strike on the floor behind it and a scorched streak cools to deep red in its wake, with sparks, embers and dust shed behind, until it thins out and dies.

name: Raikon Redline Guard
design: A red line is cut across his chest as the stance opens; a crescent barrier of red lightning stands in front of him, lit point by point and kept crackling, over a slowly turning red guard ring, then it breaks from the top down, each point throwing sparks that fall and land.

name: Raikon Storm Mantle
design: Hard red ribbons orbiting him at three heights inside a faint red mantle, short red arcs jumping between points on his body at uneven times, embers rising off him and a few arcs at his feet.

name: Sakura Drift
design: Pink petals drift and tumble round Akari on a slow wind with a faint deep-pink rim light; now and then one whole blossom drifts past and falls apart.

name: Sakura Burst
design: Petals rush in, then a big white detonation, two pink shock rings, twenty-four crescent blades flung outward and ninety petals that burst, hang and drift down in a slow pink snow.

name: Petal Impact
design: A short white contact and a pink ring, splinters thrown outward, a blossom pops open and falls apart while petals drift down.

name: Petal Shot
design: A white-hot crescent petal flies flat and fast with a pink glow, drawing a thin deep-pink streak and shedding petals that tumble down behind it.

name: Blade Petal Pillar
design: A pink ellipse flares on the floor, then a white contact, a tall pink light column and a fan of seven crescent blades shoot up while a geyser of petals rises and drifts back down.

name: Blossom Ribbon
design: A spinning blossom races along the floor; a deep-pink ribbon of light unrolls behind it while blossoms bloom open on the path and petals kick up and fall.

name: Sakura Slash
design: A pink arc sweeps through the target and sheds five crescent blade-petals along its path, then glowing petals tumble down through the cut.

name: Sakura Slash Beams
design: Three white-hot slash beams in deep-pink glow cross the target from three directions three frames apart, each flinging crescent blades and petals along its cut.

name: Spiral Petal Stream
design: Petals slide inward over a pink floor ellipse for 0.75 s, then a white release and a column of petals spirals upward in torn pink strands, and drops its petals as it dies.

name: Petal Tornado
design: A narrow column of petals spirals up in torn pink strands over a deep-pink base glow, flinging petals off its foot as it travels across the floor.

name: Petal Veil
design: Petals rush in, a white pop and a blossom mark where she was, torn pink strands swirl once and a puff of petals drifts down.

name: Petal Storm Vortex
design: The arena dims under a wine veil while two pink bands turn round the screen and hundreds of petals and crescent blades spiral inward round a white-hot eye.

name: Yashiro Titan Aura
design: A dim gold mantle the height of the Titan, gold flame licking up its sides at uneven times, rising wisps, embers drifting up off it and a faint band of light on the floor.

name: Blade Rain
design: A gold mark tightens on the floor, then a giant golden sword falls point first from the sky and drives into it with a white contact, a ring and cracks of gold light, stone and dust thrown out; the blade stands glowing a moment and is eaten away.

name: Tenrai Channel
design: The family seal turns slowly round the planted blade while gold light wells out of the cracks and pulses, sparks shoot up off the cracks at uneven times and embers rise.

name: Golden Kunai
design: A white-hot gold kunai flies flat and fast inside a gold glow, drawing a thin amber streak and shedding sparks that drop away behind it.

name: Golden Kunai Impact
design: A white contact that is gone in four frames, a gold ring, fast white streaks and drooping gold sparks thrown back along the throw, then a few embers that rise and hang.

name: Yashiro Titan Manifest
design: The family seal opens gold on the floor and motes are drawn in; a column of gold light erupts round him, halos rise up it, flame tongues lick upward, sparks shoot up and embers hang as the column thins away.

name: Iron Guard Parry
design: A gold crescent of the edge flashes across the contact with a white star, hard gold sparks fan back at the attacker, a thin enso ring opens and a few embers rise.

name: Domain Pulse
design: A white contact on the floor, a wide gold shock ring racing out along the ground with a thinner ring behind it, gold cracks under the blow, a wall of dust and stone thrown out and embers rising.

name: Tenrai Divine Thunder
design: The sky opens gold over him and a dim leader feels its way down; a massive gold bolt with a white core strikes inside a pillar of gold light, goes dark, strikes again on another path, and the pillar thins while gold cracks cool and embers rise.

name: Titan Slash
design: A long, flat gold arc sweeps low across the floor with a white leading edge and a long slice line along the ground; dust and stone are thrown up along the cut, sparks drag behind it and embers rise off the scar.

name: Crimson Moon Cut
design: A wide crimson crescent sweeps through the target with a white-hot edge and a pale outer rim like a moon halo; crimson shards spray along the cut and red motes hang and fade.

name: Golden Earthbreaker
design: A golden rune seal lights under the hammer, a white contact, three gold rings race out along the floor one after another, shafts of gold light stand up, boulders are thrown up and land, dust rolls out.

name: Hell Splitter Impact
design: A white contact on the floor, a red-hot crack opening and cooling, a crimson ring racing out, fire tongues erupting from the split from the middle outward, a fireball cooling into smoke, rock thrown up, embers rising.

name: Reaper Crescent
design: Dark strands drawn in, then a huge violet crescent sweeps open with a white-violet edge and a thin pale outer edge; violet sparks reap off it, shadow smoke rolls out and motes rise.

name: Swallow Bolt
design: A white core line shoots straight through the target with a jagged cyan bolt along it, struck again on another path, forks spitting off and sparks flying on; a dim after-flicker as it dies.

name: Tidal Crash
design: A white-blue contact, a column of water shooting up, a crown of long water streaks arcing over and falling, spray, two wave rings racing out along the floor and low mist.

name: Silent Violet Cut
design: A hair-thin white line appears whole across the target over a violet one and a long thin arc; a beat later a second cut opens across it with a small star, needles of light along it, and lilac motes drift and hang.

name: Echo Anchor
design: A tall six-sided crystal of violet light with white edges standing on a small gold seal, a gold ring turning round its waist and motes lifting off it.

name: Anchor Break
design: A white contact high on the crystal, violet shards thrown out and falling, a gold ring snapping out along the floor, a column of light shooting up and thinning, gold motes drifting down.

name: Reality Editor Aura
design: A violet floor seal broken by glitch pixels, a wide ring round the body torn into jumping arcs, violet flame wisps with cyan edges past the crown, hard glitch pixels blinking well outside the body and cyan scan lines racing up.

name: Manipulator Aura
design: A turning blue Echo seal on the floor, two wide control rings circling the body, blue flame wisps licking past the crown, long control threads thrown out and pale arcs snapping over a neon sheath.

name: Observer Aura
design: A dim blue mantle, slow pale-blue curls rising and turning round the body, echo cards drifting at arm length, motes lifting and a single star glint now and then.

name: True Witness Aura
design: A turning gold-and-violet Echo seal on the floor with a counter-turning ring outside it, a magenta column, gold sparks shooting up off the seal to hang, magenta wisps and gold star glints.

name: Echo Bind
design: Thin blue threads drop onto Kage, a ring of light tightens round his feet and snaps shut with a small star, rings lock round his shins and chest and turn, over a turning seal.

name: Echo Step
design: A thin vertical slit of white light opens the height of a man, blue echo cards and shards burst sideways and hang, a ring snaps across the line of the step and motes are drawn back as it closes.

name: Execution Frames
design: A near-black impact card and a white star on one frame, a long white line down through the target, a huge violet crescent cutting down after it, cyan rings racing along the floor, shards thrown out low and glitch pixels hanging.

name: Echo Genesis
design: Motes and strands drawn into a raised hand, one release: the Echo System seal flares on the floor and stands up as a giant turning ring behind it, two more rings open at other tilts, glass shards fly across the frame and hang, gold glints bloom.

name: Gravity Collapse
design: A violet accretion band passing in front of a black core with a cyan rim, a second band at another tilt, violet strands and motes drawn inward along curved paths.

name: Final Judgment
design: A long gather into a point with a guide line flickering across the arena, then a near-black card and white star, a hair-thin white line the width of the screen over a wide magenta band, gold rays standing up along it and rings racing out at its ends.

name: Orbit Blade
design: A white-hot echo card spins flat and fast with a blue glow, drawing a long thin blue streak and leaving tiny cards hanging on its path.

name: Echo Shatter
design: A crack of white light in the chest core, the body's echo blowing out as cards and shards that tumble and hang, two rings snapping out, glitch pixels blinking and pale motes lifting off for a long time.

name: Void Wave
design: A tall blue-violet crescent standing on the floor races forward with a white leading edge and a dark echo behind it, shedding cards and shards on its path over a thin line skimming the floor.

name: Control Cast
design: Threads of light converge on the hand, an Echo seal flares open before the palm and turns, a ring snaps out and three long threads shoot from the palm toward the target.

name: Health Drain
design: Pale red-violet motes and thin streaks peel off Kage and stream away toward the Witness while a violet ring tightens round his chest over and over.

name: Echo Crack
design: A small white contact, a blue ring snapping across the blow, echo cards and thin glass shards spraying back out of the body along the blow and hanging.

name: Glitch Hit
design: A violet contact, the struck spot torn into hard pixel bars that blink in and out with no motion, a cyan scan line across the hit and a few violet shards.

name: Orb Burst
design: The orb bursts into a ring snapping open in its tilted plane and a second ring across it, blue threads whip out and curl, and motes are drawn back into the point.

name: Orb Shot
design: A white-hot orb in a blue glow flies with a thin ring turning round it in a tilted plane, a soft blue tail and fine threads of light shed behind it.

name: Rewrite Pillar
design: A column of hard violet and cyan glitch pixels erupts from a torn strip of floor to about a man's height, scan lines race up it and it dies back into a few hanging pixels.

name: Echo Cut
design: A wide blue crescent sweeps through the target with a white-hot edge, a thin pale echo of the arc trails it a beat later, echo cards burst off and hang, blue motes settle.

name: Broken Cut
design: A violet crescent with a cyan edge cuts through and stutters: copies of it snap in beside it two and five frames late, hard glitch pixels blink along it and violet residue lingers.

name: Anime Dust Kick
design: A short spurt of cel-shaded dust bursts back along the floor from the foot and hangs, a white streak skims the floor and a few pebbles skip.

name: Anime Ground Crack
design: A white contact, then a shattered web of fissures snaps open across the floor, white-hot in the centre and cyan outward, light shafts fan up out of the break, a shock ring races out, rock chips fly and land, and the fissures cool to deep blue and erode while cyan motes drift up.

name: Anime Impact
design: A two-frame pinch, a white contact star, a jagged cream burst over a larger amber body that snap open and erode from their spikes, radial speed lines and an air ring, warm sparks through the target and three glints that pop and pinch out.

name: Anime Mist Bank
design: Flattened pale blue-white toon cloud lobes fade in low along the floor, billow slowly as they drift downwind, and tear into hard-edged scraps as they go.

name: Anime Smoke Burst
design: A hard white starburst and flash squash onto the floor; cel-shaded white cloud banks then ease out left and right, leaving a hollow dome of clear air traced by broken white strokes; wind streaks fan along the floor, blobs of smoke spit up and fall, and the banks tear into hard-edged chunks.
